description: Compact interior arrangement and mounting scaffold for the ADRS maritime enclosure: Bedrock V3000, NSP-1600, Peplink UBR Plus, Ettus B210 and one OZ51x dual-TX Zonu housing on the subpanel, with a TE121024010 thermoelectric cooler through the left wall. Placement data lives in placement.json; this file records the enclosure datums and the fabrication stock.
material: 6061-T6 aluminium plate (scaffold); enclosure and modules are purchased
process: Saw, drill and press brake only — no machining required for any scaffold member
notes: Coordinate frame is the Saginaw vendor STEP's own, so imported geometry needs no re-datuming and it matches the existing build-layout2.STEP.

The TE12 internal loop was measured from the model: Ø120 intake grille at mid-height, discharge through top and bottom bands hugging the mounting wall. That is why X < -155 is reserved as an air plenum.

THERMAL: total load ≈150 W against a TE12 rated 94 W at ΔT=0 / ~147 W at ΔT=+15 °C. The cabinet will settle near ambient +15 °C. The 200 W TE162024020 fits the same wall and is the recommended upgrade — see DESIGN_NOTES.md.
The Bedrock vendor STEP contains three mutually exclusive chassis variants at one origin (29 / 45 / 73 mm wide). This layout reserves the 73 mm 60 W worst case.
The OZ51x housing has no external mounting features of any kind — it needs the cradle plate plus side straps, or mounting ears added to its own model.
The Ettus B210's four bottom bores are offset 3.05 mm from the case centre; a symmetric bracket will not fit.
